fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Classes Aug 24 - Dec 8, 2026 (Fall Break Oct 12-13; Thanksgiving Nov 23-28; orientation held week before classes start per Fact Sheet p.1).
fall_term_dates.notes: Orientation timing from data/raw/factsheets/The George Washington University/2026-2027/Elliott School Fact Sheet ( Updated).pdf#page=1.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Classes Jan 11 - Apr 26, 2027; Final Exams May 1 - May 7, 2027 (Spring Break Mar 8-13; orientation held week before classes start per Fact Sheet p.1).
spring_term_dates.notes: Orientation timing from data/raw/factsheets/The George Washington University/2026-2027/Elliott School Fact Sheet ( Updated).pdf#page=1.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory GW Student Health Insurance Plan (Aetna SHIP): F-1 and J-1 international students are automatically enrolled and billed to their student account unless granted an approved waiver meeting strict ACA/D.C.-network standards. U.S. Dept. of State J-1 minimums apply ($100,000 medical/accident, $25,000 repatriation, $50,000 evacuation, <=$500 deductible).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Student billing info at https://studentaccounts.gwu.edu/student-health-insurance; J-1 federal insurance minimums verified via https://internationalservices.gwu.edu/.

housing_notes.value: No on-campus housing for Master's exchange students; must arrange off-campus housing independently. Resources provided by Off-Campus Student Affairs (https://www.gwoffcampus.com/) and International Student House DC (http://www.ishdc.org/).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/The George Washington University/2026-2027/Elliott School Fact Sheet ( Updated).pdf#page=1

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Exchange Visitor Visa required (GW issues Form DS-2019 upon acceptance). Applicants must submit original English/USD financial documentation matching program cost estimates for DS-2019 issuance (exact DS-2019 processing lead time and Elliott-specific exchange living budget not published in Fact Sheet).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/The George Washington University/2026-2027/Elliott School Fact Sheet ( Updated).pdf#page=1
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: ISO pre-arrival & financial doc rules on https://internationalservices.gwu.edu/before-you-arrive (excluded J-1 Student Interns $2,000/mo threshold and CCAS VRF $24,000/yr as non-Elliott cohorts).
